short: Imperial Japan formally surrendered to the Allied powers aboard the USS Missouri, ending the Second World War.
full:
On 2 September 1945, representatives of the Japanese government and military signed the Japanese Instrument of Surrender aboard the US Navy battleship USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay. Following the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki and the Soviet invasion of Manchuria in early August, Emperor Hirohito had announced Japan's capitulation in a radio broadcast on 15 August. US General Douglas MacArthur accepted the formal surrender on behalf of the Allied powers.

The ceremony marked the absolute conclusion of the Second World War. The surrender spared Japan from a massive Allied invasion and began a period of American occupation and extensive political, economic, and social reforms under MacArthur's administration. The Japanese Empire was dismantled, and the nation adopted a new pacifist constitution in 1947.
